title: Stock Market Close: Sensex sprints 487 pts, Nifty nears 25,350; Oil & Gas index jumps 3%, Metal 2%
text:
Sensex today | Stock Market LIVE Updates, Wednesday, January 28, 2026:

Indian benchmark indices -- Sensex and Nifty -- managed to eke out gains on Wednesday, despite volatile moves through the day. Investors reacted to Q3FY26 results along with the finalisation of the India-European Union Free Trade Agreement (FTA).

The BSE Sensex index closed the session at 82,345, higher by 487 points or 0.60 per cent. The 30-stock index hit a high of 82,504 and a low of 81,815 during the session.

The Nifty50, meanwhile, shut shop at 25,343, clocking a gain of 167 points or 0.66 per cent. It traded between 25,188 amd 25,372.

BEL shares zoomed 9 per cent, closing as the top gainer on the Sensex, and Nifty indices. Besides, ONGC, Coal India, Eternal. HIndalco, Baja Finance, Power Grid, Adani Enterprises, Trent, M&M, Cipla, and Shriram Finance were the other top gainers on the Nifty today.

On the downside, Tata Consumer share price fell 4.5 per cent, while Asian Paints, Maruti Suzuki, Sun Pharma, Max Health, Dr Reddy's, Infosys, and Eicher Motors dropped up to 4.2 per cent.

Broader markets outperformed the benchmark indices with the Nifty MidCap 100 and the Nifty SmallCap 100 closing with gains of 1.66 per cent and 2.26 per cent, respectively.

Among sectors, the Nifty CPSE index rallied 5 per cent, the Nifty Oil & Gas 3.4 per cent, the Nifty Metal 2.3 per cent, and the Nifty PSU Bank 1.7 per cent.
